question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Cynical
solution:
The correct answer is "**Optimistic**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Cynical" means distrustful or pessimistic.**(निंदक)

 
 
• Example: He gave a cynical laugh.
 
 
 
• **Optimistic means hopeful or confident.**(आशावादी)
 
 
• Example: She is an optimistic person.
 
 
 
 
 
• The antonym of a word is a word that means the opposite of it.
 
• Therefore, the antonym of cynical is optimistic.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Negligent means careless or irresponsible.(लापरवाह)
 
• Silent means quiet or not speaking.(चुपचाप)
 
• Usurper means someone who takes power or authority without the right to do so.(हड़पनेवाला)
